survey.company: Carolina Flexible Packaging Inc. (owned by a German packaging group)
survey.description: Retaliation after reporting machine guarding problems

evidence.summary: Receipt of an OSHA complaint filed online on 3 June about missing machine guards on laminating line 2, complainant name withheld.

conversation: I am a shop steward at a flexible packaging plant. The guards on laminating line 2 were removed to run faster. In April a worker lost two fingers.
I am very sorry. What happened after the accident?
I raised it with the plant manager and nothing changed, so I filed an OSHA complaint on 3 June. I uploaded the receipt.
Has there been any reaction from the company?
Two weeks later I was moved to the night shift and written up twice for small things I never got written up for before. Cameras were installed facing the break room where we have union meetings.

Two coworkers who signed a statement about the accident were told by a supervisor that 'people who talk to outsiders don't last here'. The company is owned by a German group that publishes a human rights policy.
